difficulty_reason: For X -> Y -> Z with the composition g circ f ind-quasi-affine, the lemma concludes f itself is ind-quasi-affine — the left-permanence law of the class. The retained proof is written via the chapter's alternative-definition dictionary (card L16109, collected): the property can be checked Zariski locally, so replace Z by an affine open and then Y by an affine open as well (dictionary clause (2) testing on affines); once Z and Y are affine, every quasi-compact open U of X has U -> Y ind-quasi-affine-testable and in fact U -> Z quasi-affine gives U quasi-affine over the affine Z, hence over Y by the dictionary's descent through affines — the author's two-line deployment of the dictionary closes it. Retained author proof at lines 19626-19632.
